pages.title: World Bank Water–Food Nexus Framework report

facts.text: World Bank report released ahead of World Water Day 2026 — proposes a "Water-Food Nexus Framework"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Population to reach ~10 billion by 2050; current systems can sustainably feed only ~3.4 billion
facts.head: News

facts.text: Climate change by 2050: food production down 6–14%; up to 1.36 billion in severe food insecurity
facts.head: News

facts.text: Two dimensions: water stress level + position in food trade (net importer/exporter)
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Four categories: water-secure importer, water-secure exporter, water-stressed exporter, water-stressed importer
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: ⚠ India = water-stressed food exporter — groundwater over-extraction in Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, western UP
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Data: geospatial + household surveys across 58 countries
